clockPolicy: Keep raw coverage receipts separate; visible/padded clocks additionally require assetsReady, runtimeReady and visibleDrawRecords>0. Independent readyAt is unchanged. Ground sampling remains mandatory.
boundary: Local frozen frontend files fulfilled only at the originally authorized frontend origin; all DO HTTP/WebSocket requests remain real. This is not hosted frontend parity. Barrier case is a dependency proof, not a latency benchmark.
